notes.title: Project Updated to 5.5
notes.content:
The project was recently updated to a newer version of Unreal Engine. This means I have more options to work with but also means there's a possibility that some things in the playtest may have have broken which is a very common thing when upgrading.

Please inform me asap if something worked in the past but suddenly no longer works now.

notes.title: Completely new build
notes.content:
- New Quest Journal system
- Manual saving and loading
- Experimental light detection system
- New pickpocket and NPC inventory system

Important Note:
- To pickpocket, you must be crouched and the NPC must be unaware of you.
- Lanterns are still activated by pressing F but now requires you to actually have a lantern in your inventory.
